collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager steps outside early and finds every leaf in the garden beaded with dew.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) steps outside early and finds every leaf in the garden beaded with dew. The droplets sparkle as the first sunlight reaches them.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) steps outside early and finds every leaf in the garden beaded with dew. (name1) brushes a branch and gets a cold shower on the neck.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) steps outside early and finds every leaf in the garden beaded with dew. A small bird drinks from a leaf just beside (name1)'s hand.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) steps outside early and finds every leaf in the garden beaded with dew. By the time (name1) fetches a friend to see, the dew has gone.
